gui.jaymoskingdoms.controls.title: Controls
gui.jaymoskingdoms.controls.vampire.note: Each costs blood. One run into the next costs half.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.controls.dhampir.note: A dhampir pays no blood and has no shapes.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.controls.vampire.dash: Thrown where you look; up, a great leap.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.controls.vampire.poun: In the air: down like a stone. Then Rend.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.controls.vampire.gaze: A red laser out of the eyes.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.controls.vampire.feed: Grab and drink; again to throw.
A small flying body. Again: back.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.controls.vampire.colo: Bats lift the foe ahead and drop it.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.controls.vampire.mist: Nothing hurts you. Ends in a leap.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.controls.vampire.rake: Three quick slashes, each a wound.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.controls.vampire.rend: One tearing blow; kills the near-dead.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.controls.vampire.poun: Fly at a foe and pin it.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.controls.vampire.leap: Empty hand: a jump; locked on, a leap.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.controls.vampire.give: Give in to the blood fever.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.controls.vampire.stak: Work loose the stakes in you.
